weighted_aggregation.note: Fixed-degree and bounded-ragged (maximum degree <=64) F=1/F=16/F=64 CSR use compiler-emitted TTIR; unsupported high-degree vector shapes explicitly dispatch to torch.sparse.mm. The fixed random/i32/N=131072/degree16 gate reports F16 hot/cold at 4.322x/3.801x and F64 at 1.966x/1.302x. The irregular degree-0..32 gate reports F16 hot/cold at 4.213x/3.270x and F64 at 1.595x/1.283x, with all 95% CI lows above 1.0. Discrete social-like power-law covers local/random, i32/i64 and hot/cold: public prepared_auto passes all eight gates with CI lows 1.255-1.849. The CDF-planned, compiler-generated chunked-tail TTIR is separately gated for i32 and reaches 1.353-1.525x over torch.sparse.mm with CI lows 1.337-1.495. Continuous log-normal and exponential random/i32/F1 cases record full degree statistics; generated chunked-tail TTIR passes hot/cold at 1.196x/1.157x and 1.204x/1.439x, with CI lows 1.186/1.138 and 1.198/1.376. Auto retains and may select a faster reusable native CSR executable. Providers are sampled in rotating interleaved order to remove thermal/order drift.

diffusion.note: Each case separates compiler-generated GraphForge points from benchmark-only peers.

radius_graph_build.note: Useful FLOPs count exact candidate distance tests; sorting and integer directory work remain explicit metadata.

radius_distance_aggregation.note: N=32768,D=2/3, non-periodic/box/skew across consume, reuse, logical rebind and true topology rebuild: all 24 strict confidence gates pass. Periodic generated traversal carries lattice/inverse and performs minimum-image filtering without CSR/distance materialization.

online_softmax.note: A benchmark-defined tuple-state UDF is structurally proven and reassociated to a 32-row max/exp/sum TTIR tile. N=131072, degree=32 passes the matched handwritten-Triton strict gate at 1.007x with 95% CI low 1.005.

knn_graph.note: Graph.knn is a procedural exhaustive Euclidean relation. The build+weighted-consume case rebuilds exact cdist/top-k columns, reuses fixed row metadata, and rebinds them to one compiler-generated TTIR consumer without recompilation. Prepared GraphForge is 3.9072 ms versus matched cdist/top-k/gather-multiply-sum at 3.9137 ms: 1.0017x with CI low 1.0005. The older build-only artifact remains an auxiliary historical optimization result; no claim is extrapolated to other shapes or ANN.

dense_matmul_calibration.note: Native gf.Tensor matmul remains gf_tensor.matmul; auto legally selects the Torch-free cuBLASLt runtime path and passes the strict external torch.mm/cuBLAS confidence gate. --provider ttir retains direct tt.dot diagnostics.

dense_attention.note: User-defined MessagePassing lowers through Domain, Iter and Kernel to compiler-emitted TTIR; the handwritten Triton implementation is benchmark-only. Full Cartesian, lower-triangular, and grouped-query (Hq=16/Hkv=4) Graph relations pass external Flash SDPA: 1.074x (CI low 1.069), 1.117x (CI low 1.100), and 1.084x (CI low 1.078), respectively.

message_passing_backward.note: Forward UDF VJPs are compiler-derived; handwritten kernels remain matched benchmark peers. The captured non-additive product reducer uses a zero-safe row-tiled VJP and passes at 1.021x (95% CI low 1.016). Dynamic Euclidean radius uses a fixed selected-topology snapshot and compiler-emitted gf_tensor.csr_euclidean_distance_sum_vjp; N=32768,D=3,degree~32 passes at 1.079x (95% CI [1.073,1.082]) over matched handwritten Triton and 4.36x over torch.autograd.

linear_attention.note: An ordinary broadcast/multiply/cumsum/sum Tensor expression is structurally fused to one recurrent TTIR kernel. The exact causal unnormalized recurrence passes the official FLA recurrent/chunk confidence gate; the rank-four prefix state is never materialized.

sparse_attention.note: A benchmark-defined MessagePassing workload uses online_softmax(block_prune_threshold=D/N). The threshold survives reducer IR and generic dense streaming lowering emits dynamic tile admission; the registered noncausal case passes official flash-sparse-attn at 1.182x (95% CI low 1.177). Both approximate outputs are accuracy-audited against exact Flash SDPA.

cpu_pointwise_fusion.note: Ordinary Tensor pointwise IR lowers to 512-bit semantic vectors, LLVM and a lazily-created persistent worker pool. The registered 4M-element case passes torch.compile/Inductor at 1.073x with 95% CI low 1.053.

cpu_relation.note: A native MessagePassing gather/UDF/CSR-reduce DAG fuses into nested LLVM loops and partitions independent destination ranges. This hot regular i32 bucket passes the fastest installed provider-native CSR peer at 6.318x with 95% CI low 5.540; no claim is extrapolated to ragged or power-law CPU graphs.

pagerank.note: One gf_control.repeat captures the recurrence and launches one structurally fused CSR-message/reduction/node-epilogue TTIR kernel per iteration with two ping-pong buffers. Each degree/size bucket is confidence-gated against an identical fixed-iteration torch.sparse.mm recurrence; device-side convergence and cuGraph/GraphBLAS comparisons remain pending.

visualization_heatmap.note: The separate visualization product layer composes ordinary broadcast/add/mul/div Tensor IR; no heatmap op exists in core. Stable animation buffers use Tensor.prepare(). The registered 2048x2048 scalar-to-RGB case is 1.153x over torch.compile/Inductor with 95% CI low 1.140; cold JIT and PNG encoding are reported outside the hot kernel gate.
